toFix.problem: For some reason when uploading a new version it wont show it as a new version in the runtime loading sequence and the user isn't notified of the newest verion available.
toFix.possible: Might not be a bug, and just be the upload speed of the server and hosting

toFix.state: is a boolean that shows if the issue has been resolved or not
toFix.file: is what the dev has to inspect for fixing
toFix.problem: is a message that explains what the problem is
toFix.possible: is a message of what might cause the issue
toFix.feedback: is a message left by a tester/dev/user about the known issue to help locate the problem
toFix.infoOfThisAction: The fix one is the most important out of all the actions here. The fix is where crucial bugs are listed, letting the dev know that they need to fix it immediately or the app won't work

toOptimise.state: is a boolean that shows if the issue has been resolved or not
toOptimise.file: is what the dev has to optimise
toOptimise.feedback: is a message left by tester/dev/user
toOptimise.infoOfThisAction: The optimise is the second most crucial action. The need for optimisation is when the app is using too many resources for an action/actions and it makes the app cost effective or slow.

toRework.state: is a boolean that shows if the issue has been resolved or not
toRework.file: is what the dev has to rework
toRework.infoOfThisAction: The rework is the least crucial action category. It's not a user side problem or a runtime problem. Mainly it's a programmer problem where the dev has to make the code easier to read and use. None effecting the userbase or the server/backend
